Great questions 6 answers below and next steps.

Burst model (summary):
- Baseline quota: provisioned monthly quota (we size to your baseline; changes require a quota request).
- Burst window: short-term burst capacity is applied per route/service and is intended for 24 672 hour campaign spikes. We support temporary burst multipliers up to 4x baseline for pre-approved campaigns; ad-hoc bursts are permitted but subject to overage rules.
- Frequency: we typically allow 1 62 approved burst events per quarter as part of the hosted plan; more frequent sustained bursts indicate a fit for Dedicated.
- Latency: bursts are served on our shared hosted fleet; small risk of increased tail latency in extreme contention but we use priority routing for approved bursts.

Overage terms & pricing (hosted):
- Approved bursts: no overage charge for approved burst windows (requires request 48 672 hours ahead for guaranteed routing).
- Unapproved overages: billed at the on-demand overage rate of $35 per 1M tokens for excess usage beyond approved bursts/quota in the billing month.
- Unit economics estimate: with standard batching + prefix caching we expect an effective unit of ~$22 per 1M tokens for your workload profile; with heavy unapproved spikes it can run closer to the $35/1M overage rate.

Quota increase / procurement flow:
- Small/temporary increases: submit a quota increase request in the Console (we'll auto-evaluate and reply within 24 648 hours).
- Permanent increases >2x baseline or recurring high-volume needs: require a short amendment (procurement + legal) and potentially Reserved/Dedicated sizing.

Options I recommend for Acme:
A) Hosted + approved burst plan: keep baseline at 50M/month, approve up to two 48 672h bursts at up to 4x baseline per quarter. Expected blended $/1M  $22.
B) Dedicated reserved capacity: if you expect sustained >40 650M/month and frequent bursts, we'll price reserved pools  lower unit cost and guaranteed SLA for tail latency.

I'll prepare a short pricing proposal with both options and estimated monthly cost ranges given the numbers above. Rafael  could you confirm procurement/PO requirements and whether Net30 is needed? Alex  once you send the 14-day sample we'll run it through the estimator and return a recommended configuration.

Thanks 6 Marissa
